question.text: What is the STT rate applicable to the seller of equity futures contracts?

answer.text: 0.02% of the traded price (applicable on the seller of futures)
0.125% of the traded price (applicable on both buyer and seller)
0.0125% of the premium (applicable on the buyer of futures)
0.05% of the settlement price (applicable on the clearing corporation)

explanation.text: The Logic: STT on the sale of equity futures is 0.02%, payable by the seller and computed on the actual traded price. The Trap: The buyer does not pay STT on futures. STT is computed on the traded price for futures, not the settlement price. Note: A separate STT line applies to options — STT on exercised equity options is 0.125% payable by the purchaser on the settlement price; the 0.02% rate here is specific to futures.
